_meta.region: Milwaukee / Wisconsin (incl. Artisan Partners distributed teams)
notes: Artisan Partners is HQ Milwaukee but investment TEAMS are distributed — ingested each PM at the team's real office city: Growth->Milwaukee, U.S. Value->Atlanta, Global Value->Chicago, International Value->Boston, Global Equity+Developing World->San Francisco, Sustainable EM->New York, Antero Peak->Denver.
Mason Street is a captive Northwestern Mutual adviser (in CRM, not registered as NDR target).
Broadview and Mason Street rosters flagged to re-verify before outreach.

Artisan Partners.reason: Publicly traded (NYSE: APAM) fundamental active-equity manager, HQ Milwaukee, teams distributed across offices. Equity teams only (fixed-income teams excluded).

Fiduciary Management, Inc. (FMI).reason: Independent Milwaukee value manager (est. 1980, ~$9.1B). Focused fundamental value (Large/All Cap, International). Prime NDR target.

Baird Equity Asset Management.reason: Active-equity arm of Robert W. Baird (HQ Milwaukee). U.S. Growth team runs Mid Cap and Small/Mid Cap Growth. (Baird Advisors fixed-income excluded.)

Nicholas Company, Inc..reason: Milwaukee family-founded active-equity manager (Albert Nicholas heritage; now David O. Nicholas). Nicholas family of funds. Distinct from San Diego's 'Nicholas Investment Partners'.

Mason Street Advisors.reason: Wholly-owned Northwestern Mutual adviser running active equity sleeves for proprietary funds. CAPTIVE in-house adviser -> weak NDR fit; in CRM but not an NDR target. Roster to re-verify.

Madison Investments.reason: Employee-owned active manager (Madison, WI) running bottom-up 'moat'-style equity (Large/Mid Cap). Advises the Madison Funds.

Broadview Advisors, LLC.reason: Milwaukee small/mid-cap value manager (est. 2001, ~$400M). Former Broadview Opportunity Fund folded into Madison 2019; SMA equity manager continues. Roster from aggregator — re-verify.

Cortina Asset Management.reason: Former Milwaukee small-cap growth shop acquired by Silvercrest Asset Management in 2019 — merged/renamed, no longer independent.
